title: BUG: Fix `VibrationsData.todict` for when `1 != len(VibrationsData._indices) != len(VibrationsData._atoms)`
body:
This MR fixes the bug described in #1650 by modifying the condition in `VibrationsData.todict`. Because `len(VibrationsData._indices)` is not necessarily equal to `len(VibrationsData._atoms)`, the previous condition would result in an error instead of evaluating to False. The fix now checks if `VibrationsData._indices` matches what would be produced by `Vibrations.indices_from_constraints` by first comparing length and *then* checking element equality.

Closes #1650
